description: This file contains utility functions for handling JSON responses, error handling, and establishing gRPC connections within the 'operator' package of an Android Cuttlefish frontend project. It defines an interface for JSON connections, functions for replying with JSON data or errors over HTTP, and a function to connect to a Control Environment Proxy Server via gRPC.

methods.name: ReplyError
methods.description: Logs an error message and sends it as a JSON error message over a JSON connection.

methods.name: ReplyJSONOK
methods.description: Sends a successful JSON response with HTTP status 200.

methods.name: ReplyJSONErr
methods.description: Logs an error and sends an error message as a JSON response, handling AppError types specifically.

methods.name: ReplyJSON
methods.description: Sends a generic JSON response with a specified HTTP status code.

methods.name: ConnectControlEnvProxyServer
methods.description: Establishes a gRPC connection to the Control Environment Proxy Server for a specific device, given its ID and a device pool.
